cluster_reason: AccumulatorPathVisitor, CountingPathVisitor and Counters form a cohesive visitor/counting cluster: both visitor implementations rely on the Counters utility and share counting/accumulation responsibilities. Moving them together isolates visitor-specific logic from the broader file utilities without separating tightly-coupled classes, minimizing required visibility changes between these classes.

blocks.goal: Move the visitor/counting cluster (AccumulatorPathVisitor, CountingPathVisitor, Counters) into a dedicated subpackage to reduce God Component size.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.io.file.visitor if it does not exist.
Move AccumulatorPathVisitor to the visitor subpackage alongside related visitor/counting classes.
Move CountingPathVisitor to the visitor subpackage to colocate it with its supporting Counters implementation.
Move Counters (shared by the visitor implementations) into the visitor subpackage to keep package-private interactions local after the refactor.
